$comment: Familista Cyber Defense — the reviewed security posture. The manifest (generated/security-manifest.json) says what the code IS; this file says what has been REVIEWED and accepted. tests/security-posture.unit.test.ts fails when the two disagree. Changing this file is a security review: say why in the commit.

publicRoutes.POST /auth/register: Account creation; no session can exist yet. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.POST /auth/login: Credential exchange; no session can exist yet. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.POST /auth/login/mfa: The second sign-in step; no session can exist yet. Authenticated by a single-use, hashed, five-minute challenge from the password step. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.POST /auth/refresh: Authenticated by the refresh token presented, not by an access token. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.POST /auth/logout: Revokes the presented refresh token; must work with an expired access token. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.POST /auth/forgot-password: Starts a reset for a reader who cannot sign in. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.GET /auth/reset-password/:token/validate: Authenticated by the reset token in the path. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.POST /auth/reset-password: Authenticated by the reset token in the body. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.GET /billing/plans: Public price list; returns no account data.
publicRoutes.POST /billing/webhook: Stripe calls it; authenticated by the Stripe-Signature header (stripe.webhooks.constructEvent) over the raw body.
publicRoutes.GET /invitations/preview: Shows an invitation before anybody signs in; authenticated by the invitation token.
publicRoutes.POST /invitations/accept-with-account: Creates the invited account; authenticated by the invitation token.
publicRoutes.POST /devices/auth/token: Device handshake: device-auth service requires deviceSessionId, ts, nonce and an HMAC signature before issuing a device token.
publicRoutes.POST /device-infra/devices/by-serial/:se: First activation of a provisioned device: device-registry verifies an HMAC over ts.nonce with the device credential (timingSafeEqual).
publicRoutes.POST /devices/sessions/:id/packets: acceptUserOrDevice: requires a user JWT or a device JWT; the scanner does not recognise that guard by name.
publicRoutes.POST /devices/sessions/:id/packets/batch: acceptUserOrDevice: requires a user JWT or a device JWT; the scanner does not recognise that guard by name.
publicRoutes.POST /devices/:id([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-f: acceptUserOrDevice: device-keyed alias of the packet ingest; requires a user JWT or a device JWT.
publicRoutes.POST /neuro/streams/:id/event-batch: Edge camera ingest: HMAC over the batch verified with the camera credential, nonce replay-checked (device-nonce service).
publicRoutes.POST /vision/cameras/:id/frame: Edge camera ingest: HMAC over ts.nonce.sha256(detections) verified with the camera credential.

appLevelRoutes.GET /api/health: Liveness probe for the load balancer; returns no data.
appLevelRoutes.GET /healthz: Liveness probe for the load balancer; returns no data.
appLevelRoutes.GET /app/*: Serves the static single-page shell; data is fetched with a session afterwards.
appLevelRoutes.GET /invite: Serves the static invitation page shell.
appLevelRoutes.GET /invite/*: Serves the static invitation page shell.
appLevelRoutes.GET /reset-password: Serves the static password-reset page shell.

knownGaps.login-lockout: PARTIAL — the lockout service has no enforcing caller; it runs in shadow mode only (login-lockout-shadow).
knownGaps.mfa-required-at-login: PARTIAL — required at sign-in only for an owner who switched it on (Step 7); not required for every account.
knownGaps.refresh-token-legacy-fallback-removed: ABSENT — the nullable legacy token column and the dual-read fallback stay until every pre-Step-8 refresh token has expired; removing them is a later cleanup.
knownGaps.jwt-algorithm-pinned: ABSENT — jwt.verify is called without an algorithms list.
knownGaps.jwt-issuer-validated: ABSENT — no issuer or audience is set or checked.
knownGaps.websocket-token-outside-url: ABSENT — the WebSocket token travels in the query string.
knownGaps.db-row-level-security: ABSENT — tenancy is enforced in the application only.
knownGaps.db-audit-append-only: ABSENT — the audit table can be updated or deleted by the application role.
